meaning: drachma, dram, daric-unit of weight and value (of gold, money) equal to 128 grains or 4.32 grams

elsewhere.note: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand…
twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics; and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.
